findings.desc: Recombinant human APOE4, but not APOE3, aggregated in vitro during incubation at 37 °C for up to 4 weeks: FPLC detected APOE4 emerging in higher-molecular-weight fractions, RT-QuIC Thioflavin T fluorescence increased to a plateau after 2 weeks, circular dichroism showed reduced alpha-helicity, and ultrastructure showed wavy fibrillar structures; APOE3 analyzed identically showed no Thioflavin T increase, no W222/W208 change and no molecular-weight shift. Lipidated APOE3/APOE4 particles did not aggregate in the cell-free assay.
findings.quote: FPLC analysis detected the emergence of APOE4 in the higher molecular weight fractions, indicating aggregate formation (Figure S4F).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased aggregation of APOE itself into higher-molecular-weight fibrillar species in vitro)
findings.exp_system: Recombinant human APOE3 and APOE4, FPLC-purified monomeric/tetrameric species, cell-free incubation at 37 °C for up to 4 weeks; FPLC, RT-QuIC, CD spectroscopy, electron microscopy

findings.desc: APOE aggregates were localized inside the endo-lysosomal system of microglia: in 5xFAD ApoE-Halo mice, APOE-Halo-positive MX04-positive structures inside IBA1-positive microglia were often associated with the lysosomal marker CD68, MX04-positive aggregates co-stained with LAMP1 in microglia cultures, and lysosomal dysfunction promoted their formation. The localized protein in the knockin model is mouse APOE (HaloTag fused to endogenous mouse Apoe), so this finding establishes the endo-lysosomal compartment, while the APOE4-versus-APOE3 contrast is established by the in vitro finding above.
findings.quote: APOE aggregation occurs within the endo-lysosomal system of microglia
findings.summary: (endocytic uptake of APOE by microglia) -> (APOE aggregation within the endo-lysosomal system)
findings.exp_system: 5xFAD ApoE-Halo knockin mice (HaloTag fused to endogenous mouse Apoe) and microglia cultures (BV2, primary mouse, human iPSC-derived); confocal/Airyscan imaging, CD68 and LAMP1 co-staining

findings.desc: Human APOE4 knockin 5xFAD mice showed a higher MX04-positive plaque load than APOE3 knockin or 5xFAD controls, and stereotaxic injection of in vitro-generated recombinant APOE4 aggregates significantly increased MX04-positive amyloid plaques in 5xFAD mice, whereas identically preincubated recombinant APOE3 did not: the isoform-specific APOE aggregates act as seeds/co-factors for Ab plaque formation in vivo.
findings.quote: Injection of recombinant APOE3, prepared via a 3-week preincubation, did not result in an increase in the number of MX04+ amyloid plaques in the seeding experiment (Figure 3G).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (APOE aggregates seed increased Ab plaque formation in vivo)
findings.exp_system: 5xFAD mice crossed with human APOE3 or APOE4 knockin mice; stereotaxic injection of in vitro-generated recombinant APOE aggregates into 5xFAD mice
